notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact creature.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Farid and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Farid trigger, creating a Scrap artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Scrap, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
